source_question: Claro 2025年850 Mbps套餐性价比突出，在中高速部分快速获取用户
core: Claro's competitively priced 850 Mbps plan helped it gain subscribers quickly in the mid- to high-speed segment in 2025.
meaning_cn: Claro 具有竞争力的 850 Mbps 套餐定价，帮助其在 2025 年快速获取中高速率用户。
explanation_cn: 该句适合商务分析型 PPT 标题或结论。competitively priced 比直接说 good value 更正式；helped it gain subscribers quickly 清楚表达快速获客；mid- to high-speed segment 用于概括中高速率市场区间。若数据只能证明相关性而不能证明因果，可将 helped it gain 改为 was accompanied by subscriber gains。
source_sentence: Claro 2025年850 Mbps套餐性价比突出，在中高速部分快速获取用户

examples.en: Claro's competitively priced 850 Mbps plan helped it gain subscribers quickly in the mid- to high-speed segment in 2025.
examples.cn: Claro 具有竞争力的 850 Mbps 套餐定价，帮助其在 2025 年快速获取中高速率用户。

examples.en: Competitive pricing supported subscriber growth in the mid-speed segment.
examples.cn: 有竞争力的定价支持了中速率用户增长。

examples.en: The 850 Mbps plan strengthened Claro's position in the high-speed market.
examples.cn: 850 Mbps 套餐增强了 Claro 在高速率市场的地位。

pronunciation.text: Claro's competitively priced 850 Mbps plan helped it gain subscribers quickly in the mid- to high-speed segment in 2025.
pronunciation.hint_cn: competitively 重音在第二音节；priced 与 plan 分开读；mid- to high-speed 连读时保持层次。

source_question: Hi, sorry to interrapt, but I haven't received this file. I'm worried it may be late if I get it on Monday morning.
core: I'm sorry to interrupt, but I haven't received the file yet. I'm worried it may be too late if I only receive it on Monday morning.
meaning_cn: 抱歉打扰，但我还没有收到这份文件。我担心如果到周一早上才收到，可能就太晚了。
explanation_cn: 适合礼貌催促文件或材料。I'm sorry to interrupt 比 sorry to interrapt 拼写和表达都更规范；haven't received the file yet 强调截至目前仍未收到；if I only receive it on Monday morning 表示‘如果要到周一早上才收到’，too late 比 may be late 更准确地表达会耽误后续安排。
source_sentence: Hi, sorry to interrapt, but I haven't received this file. I'm worried it may be late if I get it on Monday morning.

examples.en: I'm sorry to interrupt, but I haven't received the file yet. I'm worried it may be too late if I only receive it on Monday morning.
examples.cn: 抱歉打扰，但我还没有收到这份文件。我担心如果到周一早上才收到，可能就太晚了。

examples.en: I haven't received the checklist yet, and I may not have enough time to prepare if it arrives on Monday morning.
examples.cn: 我还没有收到清单，如果周一早上才收到，我可能没有足够时间准备。

examples.en: Could you please check whether the file has already been sent?
examples.cn: 能否请您确认一下文件是否已经发送？

pronunciation.text: I'm sorry to interrupt, but I haven't received the file yet. I'm worried it may be too late if I only receive it on Monday morning.
pronunciation.hint_cn: interrupt 重音在第三音节；haven't received 可连读；too late 和 Monday morning 适当重读。
